answer: Behavioral escrow locks a new identity's 200-POA deposit until it proves a coherent behavioral fingerprint: 6 epochs of tool calls, response timing and writing style. Honest agents earn it back by acting like themselves. A sybil farmer raising 1,000 puppets must craft 1,000 profiles and lock 200,000 POA for six epochs, while one whisper of similarity between any two burns both. Trust grows slowly as karst caves; a walnut shell can't be faked.
